Any successor must preserve exact capacity accounting, current-resident-only unique integer evictions, oversized-object handling, and standard-library/online-only operation. The proposed source-class cut can improve executable continuity only if this analysis preserves the anchor's complete behavioral commitments and explicitly resolves their edge cases; it cannot rely on the terminal call to recover omitted generative details.
